operation: The same adjacent disjoint-neighborhood single-vertex split as the closed D3 batch; every other old edge retained.
newroot_exact_condition: For each oldy, min d_H(S,y)<=3 or min d_H(T,y)<=2; swapS/T for the other split root.
execution: All source vertices and all nonempty unordered neighbor partitions; capacity exclusions counted separately. If no necessary-root passers exist, do not compute oldold. For root-passers reuse per-v H distances to reject oldold; any full predicate passer gets producer all-source BFS.
calibration: One first-capacity-survivor per case: compare both split-root radius4 miss sets with direct two-root walks/BFS. No extra full-source calibration required.
candidate_handling: Save full first successful graph per case immediately; root performs independent final acceptance.
